name: University of Limerick
description: The University of Limerick, located in the heart of Ireland, is renowned for its commitment to excellence in education, research, and innovation. Established in 1972, UL has grown into a vibrant and diverse institution, attracting students from across the globe. With state-of-the-art facilities, a beautiful campus, and a strong sense of community, UL offers an enriching academic experience in a supportive environment.
